blocks.text: Testing
Testing is the process of checking a program to make sure that it works correctly and produces the expected output.
Debugging
Debugging is the process of finding and fixing errors or bugs in a program.
Bug
A bug is an error, mistake, or fault in a program that causes it to produce an incorrect result or behave unexpectedly.
Programming Error
A programming error is a mistake in code that may prevent the program from running correctly. Common errors include syntax errors, logic errors, and runtime errors.
Unit Testing
Unit testing is a testing method in which small parts of a programme, such as individual functions, are tested separately to check whether they work correctly.
Test Case
A test case is a set of inputs, expected outputs, and conditions used to check whether a program or function is working properly.
Unittest
unittest is a built-in Python module used to create and run test cases for checking program correctness.
Pytest
pytest is a Python testing framework used to write and execute simple and powerful test cases.
Breakpoint
A breakpoint is a point in a program where execution is paused so that the programmer can check the values of variables and understand program behavior.
Watch Expression
A watch expression is used during debugging to monitor the value of a variable or expression while the program is running step by step.
Exception Handling
Exception handling is a method used to manage runtime errors so that a program does not stop suddenly during execution.
Profiling
Profiling is the process of measuring a program's performance to find which parts of the code take more time or use more resources.
Optimization
Optimization is the process of improving code so that it runs faster, uses fewer resources, or performs more efficiently.
Performance Bottleneck
A performance bottleneck is a part of a program that slows down the overall execution and reduces efficiency.
